question: Which Qwen configuration delivers useful quality, speed, cache behavior and context on this hardware?
method: An agent chooses bounded measurements from hardware evidence gaps. Coding quality uses a bounded visible-test and repair workflow followed by independent tests and source review. Coding performance uses one response with no repair feedback, retaining a degradation check against a qualified baseline. Full quality work is reserved for assessment or reassessment, not repeated at every performance point. The runner preserves exact configurations, first attempts, per-request rates, workflow time and loaded/peak memory. Submission alone never establishes quality.

admission.rule: model files plus headroom must fit in three quarters of physical memory and in the GPU wired limit; a floor, not a fit prediction
